headline: Amending the FY2027 budget by $22,500 for professional development, and a school physician contract with Dr. Nelken.
summary: Second readings are set for the superintendent evaluation policy and the building use policy. A first reading of a physical restraint policy and a private session on a student discipline matter are also listed.
items: Opening ceremony presentation from the Ella Risk school community
Public comment limited to agenda items
Consent agenda: salary warrants, expense warrants, and civic use of buildings
Superintendent update on state assessment and accountability
Old business: superintendent evaluation policy, second reading
Old business: building use policy, second reading
New business: crisis intervention physical restraint policy, first reading
Resolution amending the FY2027 budget by $22,500 from unassigned fund balance for board member professional development, conferences, and related travel, and adopting a request and approval process
Contract for school physician with Dr. Nelken
Policy working group update on a possible stakeholder engagement process
Executive session on a student discipline matter
Vote to seal executive session minutes and report on any votes taken in executive session
location: Ella Risk Elementary School, 949 Dexter St, Central Falls, RI 02863
